metric_scope: All three requested odds-ratio fields remain not_comparable: frequency ratios and single-group allele frequencies are not odds ratios; no new transformation or aliases.
review_notice: Review interpretation of author-defined about-double criterion, especially MORN2 source/table precision and primary23andMe versus additionalALFA comparison. This is narrative coding, not evidence of a newly tested clinical association.
